source_interpretation.text: The authors propose that a poorly soluble mixed acetate/oleate cadmium precursor releases reactive cadmium slowly in ODE, making release rate-limiting. The displayed Cd²⁺ and S²⁻ symbols simplify associated reactant species; the paper does not measure free-ion speciation or an exact precursor molecular structure.

evidence.locator: Main PDF p. 2–3, Precursor preparation and proposed mechanism

source_interpretation.text: Low acid/Cd feed favors the proposed mixed cadmium precursor, while high Cd/S is proposed to shift formation toward stable magic-sized products. The authors interpret persistent absorption wavelengths with changing intensities as changes in population, rather than continuous growth of one family into another. These are source interpretations supported by the displayed time courses, not a universally validated kinetic model.

evidence.locator: Main PDF p. 2–3, Figures 2–3 and mechanistic discussion

source_interpretation.text: Replacing oleic acid by octanoic acid yields Family 324 in the displayed comparison. The authors connect shorter-chain acids to smaller stable families, with other supporting examples in cited work. The comparison is not a complete independently tested parameter map; the caption abbreviation conflict is retained.

The paper relates narrow bandgap emission and a small nonresonant Stokes shift to well-defined nanocrystals. Solid-state NMR is interpreted as carboxylate attachment to surface cadmium, with distinguishable surface and core environments. The source does not supply ligand coverage or a coordinate-resolved surface structure.

evidence.locator: Main PDF p. 1–4, Optical results and Figures 4–5

source_interpretation.topic: Why size depends on the measurement
source_interpretation.text: The authors attribute larger dried TEM/XRD estimates partly to evaporation-induced aggregation or coalescence. DOSY instead measures a diffusion ratio after redispersion in toluene-d8. The sample was air-dried during its preparation, so the contrast concerns the measurement state rather than a never-dried synthesis. The differently based size estimates should not be averaged.

steps.meaning: Proposed formation of a mixed acetate/oleate cadmium precursor under the low acid/Cd formulation.
Proposed slow release of reactive cadmium from the poorly soluble precursor; the authors identify this as rate-limiting.
Sulfur precursor release represented schematically as reactive sulfur.
Proposed reversible association into a magic-sized product; the authors invoke stability and feed-ratio effects.

qualifications: Cd²⁺ and S²⁻ are simplified symbols for reactant species, not proof of isolated free ions.
Associated counterions are omitted in the author schematic.
The expressions are not balanced reaction stoichiometry or a coordinate-resolved precursor structure.
No added synthesis record or quantitative rate constant is inferred.
